title: NCL Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C — Revised & Perfected Mock 02
pattern: NCL Mining Sirdar CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 90 min · no -ve)

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which framework best aligns safety communication with regulatory bodies under Safety Management Plan (SMP) guidelines?
options: Quarterly submission of production totals and routine operational equipment reviews
Annual distribution of financial audit logs and worker shift attendance records
Monthly evaluation of environmental impact goals and local community outreach programs
Periodic reporting of safety performance metrics and proactive statutory engagement
questions.solution: Under Safety Management Plan (SMP) guidelines, safety communication with regulators (such as DGMS) focuses on continuous reporting of leading/lagging safety indicators and statutory updates.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What sequence defines the systematic hierarchy for comprehensive incident investigation?
options: Minor injury records, worker shift reassignment, and routine equipment inspection
Direct machinery damage, estimated repair costs, and operator penalty assessments
Shift supervisor logs, site cleanup procedures, and preliminary production restart
Immediate cause, contributing physical factors, and underlying root organizational issues
questions.solution: Incident investigation hierarchy systematic analysis moves from the immediate event/cause to environmental/contributing factors, down to root systemic and organizational causes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: According to CMR 2017 Regulation 153, what is the minimum statutory ventilation air quantity per person in underground coal mines?
options: 8.0 m³/min per person or 3.5 m³/tonne daily output
6.0 m³/min per person or 2.5 m³/tonne daily output
3.0 m³/min per person or 5.0 m³/tonne daily output
4.5 m³/min per person or 1.5 m³/tonne daily output
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 153 mandates a minimum ventilation quantity of 6.0 m³/min per person employed underground in the largest shift, or 2.5 m³/tonne daily output, whichever is greater.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which set of factors must be regularly monitored under mine environmental and personal safety standards?
options: Surface water run-off, soil organic nutrients, pit lighting intensity, and diesel usage
Haul road width parameters, bench slope angles, conveyor belt speed, and fuel stock
Inhalable dust, inflammable gas concentrations, ambient noise levels, and thermal microclimate
Worker commute times, canteen food standards, warehouse inventory, and shift rosters
questions.solution: Personal and environmental monitoring under statutory standards covers physical hazards (noise, heat/microclimate), dust, and hazardous gases.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What primary safety condition must be satisfied prior to firing explosives under CMR 2017 Regulation 196?
options: Withdraw all non-essential personnel to safe locations beyond the blast danger zone
Notify all neighboring surface communities and suspend transportation on external roadways
Disconnect all underground electrical lines and lock out active drainage pumping stations
Inspect all primary ventilation fan drifts and record baseline atmospheric pressure levels
questions.solution: Under CMR 2017 Reg 196, before a shot is charged, stemmed or fired, the shot-firer must ensure all persons in the vicinity have taken proper shelter and take steps to prevent anyone approaching the shot.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rescue Rules 1985, what primary role is designated to the Rescue Board?
options: Conduct annual wage negotiations and handle worker labor dispute settlement procedures
Procure heavy opencast earthmoving machinery and manage spare parts supply inventories
Oversee rescue station operations and manage emergency response across assigned zones
Approve annual coal production targets and manage environmental clearance documentation
questions.solution: Mines Rescue Rules 1985 mandate establishing a Rescue Board to govern, equip, and oversee mine rescue stations and regional rescue operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which combination correctly identifies a leading safety performance indicator alongside a lagging safety indicator?
options: Worker attendance figures paired with surface atmospheric dust concentration values
Total coal tonnage produced paired with monthly diesel fuel consumption statistics
Completed safety training hours paired with Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate metrics
Equipment maintenance downtime paired with scheduled conveyor belt replacement costs
questions.solution: Training hours measure proactive effort (Leading Indicator), while LTIFR measures historical accident performance (Lagging Indicator).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: According to CMR 2017 Regulation 129, to whom must the manager refer if a Sirdar's district size prevents full inspection?
options: The General Manager or Internal Safety Officer
The Chief Inspector of Mines
The Safety Committee Secretary or Worker Representative
The Area Mechanical Engineer or Colliery Surveyor
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129(2) provides that if a Sirdar's district size prevents complete statutory inspection, the manager must refer the matter to the Chief Inspector of Mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Why are water-gel explosives preferred over dry ANFO mixtures in wet blast hole conditions?
options: They generate lower overall heat output and simplify bulk transportation logistics
They produce zero toxic fumes and eliminate ground vibration during bench blasting
They exhibit superior water resistance and retain detonation sensitivity underwater
They require significantly lower initiation energy and possess infinite shelf life
questions.solution: Water-gel/slurry explosives exhibit high water resistance, allowing effective detonation in wet blast holes where dry ANFO dissolves.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What floor slope gradient range effectively directs pit water to sumps without impairing heavy earthmoving machinery?
options: 1 in 50 to 1 in 100
1 in 10 to 1 in 20
1 in 200 to 1 in 500
1 in 5 to 1 in 15
questions.solution: A floor slope gradient of 1% to 2% (1 in 100 to 1 in 50) directs water naturally toward pit sumps without impacting heavy machinery mobility.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Who is statutorily required to carry an approved Self-Rescuer apparatus while underground in a coal mine?
options: Only shot-firers, face workers, and timber setter crews
Every person entering underground coal mine workings
Only ventilation technicians and electrical maintenance staff
Only supervisory officials and rescue team personnel
questions.solution: It is statutory for every person descending underground in a coal mine to be equipped with an approved Self-Rescuer.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What information must be recorded in Form J accident register under Rule 77A of Mines Rules 1955?
options: Production loss, damaged machine value, supervisor shift logs, and repair schedules
Worker employment history, medical insurance status, wage scale, and training credits
Safety committee minutes, witness phone numbers, police contact logs, and legal fees
Date, time, location, injury details, cause, affected person info, and remedial actions
questions.solution: The accident register maintained under Rule 77A of Mines Rules 1955 (Form J) records complete details regarding the incident, injury, affected person, and corrective measures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which option presents the correct order of the standard Hierarchy of Hazard Controls?
options: Substitution, Administrative Controls, PPE, Engineering Controls, Elimination
PPE, Administrative Controls, Engineering Controls, Substitution, Elimination
Elimination, Substitution, Engineering Controls, Administrative Controls, PPE
Engineering Controls, Elimination, Substitution, PPE, Administrative Controls
questions.solution: Standard Hierarchy of Controls moves sequentially from Elimination (most effective) to Substitution, Engineering Controls, Administrative Controls, and PPE (least effective).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: How does an increase in the stripping ratio affect opencast mining operations?
options: Reduces overall diesel fuel consumption per tonne of coal extracted from deep pit benches
Decreases required dump footprint while increasing coal excavation speed and recovery rate
Increases waste overburden volume generated per unit coal and expands required dump areas
Eliminates need for secondary blasting and simplifies haul road drainage layout maintenance
questions.solution: A higher stripping ratio indicates more overburden generated per tonne of coal, necessitating larger dump areas and greater backfilling capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What dual hazards are mitigated by implementing regular water spraying on opencast haul roads?
options: High ground vibration levels and spontaneous combustion risk along unworked coal seams
Spillages from overfilled haulers and accelerated tire tread wear caused by loose sharp stones
Occupational respiratory pneumoconiosis and vehicle collisions resulting from low visibility
Excessive machine engine overheating and sudden structural failure of haul road safety berms
questions.solution: Haul road dust suppression reduces inhalable dust causing occupational respiratory diseases (Pneumoconiosis/Silicosis) and maintains line-of-sight visibility for heavy earthmovers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the primary ecological benefit of converting exhausted final voids into pit lakes?
options: Generate immediate commercial revenue through underground thermal energy production
Provide local groundwater recharge sources and establish aquatic eco-restoration zones
Eliminate requirement for topsoil application across surrounding waste rock dump slopes
Prevent formation of acid mine drainage in surrounding pyritic geological formations
questions.solution: Converting exhausted open pits into final void lakes aids regional groundwater recharge and ecological restoration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the primary function of a detonator in a blast hole initiation sequence?
options: Initiate high-order shock wave transformation in the secondary explosive column
Neutralize toxic carbon monoxide and nitrous oxide gas emissions inside blast holes
Seal upper stem section to prevent gas leakage during explosive energy release
Expand borehole diameter through mechanical pre-fracturing of hard surrounding rock
questions.solution: Detonators deliver a high-velocity shock pulse required to reliably detonate cap-sensitive charges or primers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the minimum radius of the blast danger zone in opencast mines under CMR 2017 Regulation 196?
options: 150 meters
500 meters
1000 meters
300 meters
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 196(2)(b) specifies establishing a blast danger zone radius of at least 500 meters in opencast mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Why is higher explosive energy concentration required at the toe section of a bench blast hole?
options: Water accumulation in toe zones neutralizes standard low-density explosive charge columns
Bench crest rock exhibits higher tensile strength than lower floor rock formations
Toe rock experiences maximum physical confinement and requires extra energy to break cleanly
Upper stemming material absorbs all detonation energy and weakens the top fracture zone
questions.solution: The toe section at the base of the bench has the highest rock resistance and confinement, necessitating high-energy bottom charges.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What statutory process validates Emergency Response Plans under CMR 2017 Regulation 252?
options: Approval by equipment vendors and posting on company public social media channels
Submission to local municipal bodies and annual publication in regional daily newspapers
Regular updating, workforce communication, and active validation using periodic mock drills
Review by external financial auditors and inclusion in corporate annual shareholder reports
questions.solution: Emergency Plans under CMR 2017 Reg 252 must be continuously updated, communicated, and validated through regular drills and mock rehearsals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Besides a Shot-firer competency certificate, what additional statutory certificates are mandatory for a Shot-firer?
options: Overman Certificate and Environmental Auditor Certificate
Gas Testing Certificate and First Aid Certificate
Surveyor Certificate and Winding Engine Driver Certificate
Manager Certificate and Heavy Vehicle Driving License
questions.solution: Statutory qualifications for a Shot-firer require holding a valid Shot-firer/Sirdar certificate, a Gas Testing Certificate, and a First Aid Certificate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.topic: Opencast Machinery & Heavy Earth Moving Equipment
questions.stem: What defines the operational method known as blast casting in opencast coal mining?
options: Displacing overburden directly into adjacent mined-out pit voids using explosive energy
Pumping slurry waste into deep underground stopes to prevent surface land subsidence
Drilling large diameter relief holes along pit slopes to stabilize soft wall strata
Crushing overburden rock using in-pit mobile crushers before loading onto haul trucks
questions.solution: Blast casting and casting dozers displace/throw overburden directly into the adjacent excavated pit cut, cutting down truck hauling costs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What structural principle explains how resin roof bolts stabilize underground roof strata?
options: Binding laminated roof rock layers together to form a stiff, monolithic composite beam
Transferring horizontal tectonic stress into vertical floor pillars via flexible steel rods
Expanding natural rock fractures to allow internal mine gas drainage and pressure relief
Suspending heavy immediate roof rock directly from soft surface soil layers above
questions.solution: Resin roof bolts bind weak, layered roof strata together into a rigid structural beam (Beam Building Concept).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: How is representation structured on Canteen Management Committees under Mines Rules 1955?
options: Equal numerical representation from mine management and elected worker representatives
Exclusive representation by union leadership with advisory management observers
Total control by DGMS regional officials with nominated worker assistance
Majority representation from external catering contractors and local food inspectors
questions.solution: Canteen Management Committees under Mines Rules 1955 require equal numerical representation from management and workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Why are leguminous plant species selected during biological reclamation of mine spoil dumps?
options: They eliminate need for topsoil application and accelerate rock weathering processes
They fix atmospheric nitrogen into spoil soil and bind surface soil to resist erosion
They absorb toxic heavy metals rapidly while requiring zero surface solar radiation
They prevent spontaneous heating in sub-surface coal seams by absorbing residual oxygen
questions.solution: Leguminous plants fix atmospheric nitrogen into the spoil and anchor soil particles with root systems to curb erosion.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under DGMS safety circulars, what is the required height for safety berms along haul roads?
options: Fixed at a uniform 1.0 meter height regardless of dumper size
Equal to half the height of the largest haulage dumper tire
Not less than the height of the largest dumper tire
At least double the total height of the largest dumper deployed
questions.solution: DGMS safety circulars mandate that safety berms/bunds along haul road edges must be at least as high as the largest vehicle tire.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Section 22 of the Mines Act 1952, when can an Inspector issue an order prohibiting employment?
options: When an urgent and immediate danger exists to the safety or health of mine workers
When minor administrative register discrepancies are identified during routine visits
When worker canteen food prices exceed standard subsidy thresholds approved by management
When a mine fails to achieve its targeted monthly coal production quotas
questions.solution: Section 22 of the Mines Act 1952 grants Inspectors the authority to stop employment/operations if immediate hazards endanger human lives.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the primary purpose of drilling cut holes in underground face blasting patterns?
options: Drain trapped methane gas from rock strata prior to loading main explosive charges
Provide smooth perimeter walls to reduce roof support requirements along roadways
Allow insertion of temporary timber props right up to solid working faces
Create an initial void and second free face for subsequent production blast holes
questions.solution: A cut hole pattern (e.g., wedge, burn cut) blasts out an initial central void, supplying a second free face for subsequent blasting rows.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In opencast haulage operations, what does the operational term 'spotting' refer to?
options: Marking individual drill hole locations on bench surfaces using surveyor instrumentation
Detecting micro-cracks in heavy earthmoving equipment frames during scheduled maintenance
Identifying sub-surface coal seam burning zones using thermal infrared handheld cameras
Maneuvering and positioning a dumper accurately inside the excavator loading zone
questions.solution: Spotting refers to maneuvering and aligning the dumper correctly under the excavator/shovel bucket for safe loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Why must topsoil be stripped separately and stored prior to major excavation in opencast mines?
options: Prevent topsoil from mixing with underlying high-grade coal seams during production
Preserve natural seed banks and organic nutrients required for post-mining revegetation
Use topsoil as effective blast hole stemming material to reduce explosive usage
Build high stability internal haul roads capable of supporting heavy truck axle loads
questions.solution: Topsoil contains beneficial microbes, nutrients, and native seeds essential for successful revegetation after mining operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: According to CMR 2017 Regulation 64, how frequently must mine working plans be updated?
options: At least once every 3 months
At least once every 12 months
At least once every 1 month
At least once every 6 months
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 64 requires statutory mine working plans and sections to be updated at least once every 3 months.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under DGMS circulars, what is the maximum permissible noise exposure limit for an 8-hour shift?
options: 90 dB(A)
85 dB(A)
75 dB(A)
questions.solution: DGMS circulars fix the permissible noise exposure limit at 85 dB(A) for an 8-hour shift work period.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: How must statutory reports made by inspecting mine officials be maintained at the mine?
options: Recorded in a bound paged book maintained specifically at the mine office for that purpose
Written on loose-leaf sheets pinned to district notice boards until the end of the shift
Dictated to shift clerk personnel for oral presentation during monthly safety meetings
Stored as digital notes on personal mobile devices and uploaded weekly to cloud servers
questions.solution: Statutory reports made by mine officials must be documented in official bound-paged registers kept at the mine office.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, by what date must annual statistical returns be submitted to DGMS?
options: On or before 30th April of the succeeding year
On or before 31st March of the succeeding year
On or before 20th February of the succeeding year
On or before 1st January of the succeeding year
questions.solution: Under the Mines Act 1952, annual statistical returns for the preceding year must be submitted to DGMS on or before February 20th.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Whose prior written permission is mandatory before commencing depillaring operations under CMR 2017 Reg 112?
options: The Secretary of the Safety Committee
The General Manager of the Area
The Regional Inspector of Mines
The Internal Safety Officer
questions.solution: Depillaring and pillar extraction operations require prior written permission and approval of the extraction layout from the Regional Inspector (CMR 2017 Reg 112).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the standard maximum gradient permitted for opencast haul roads under CMR 2017 Regulation 101?
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 101 limits opencast haul road gradients to a maximum of 1 in 16 (6.25%).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In opencast mining terminology, what does the term 'highwall' designate?
options: The temporary retaining wall built along haul roads to catch loose falling stones
The raised earth bund constructed around mine pit perimeters to divert floodwater
The unexcavated, steep rock and coal face exposing the outer boundary of the pit cut
The terraced side slope of an external overburden waste dump undergoing revegetation
questions.solution: The highwall is the unexcavated rock/coal face exposing the pit boundary during benching/stripping.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What parameters are directly influenced by the choice of blast hole diameter in bench blasting?
options: Pit sump pumping capacity, drainage ditch slope, and settle pond detention time
Surface land acquisition costs, local compensation rates, and forestry clearance time
Drill pattern spacing, explosive powder factor, and resulting rock fragmentation size
Haul road width requirements, dumper travel speed, and tire pressure specifications
questions.solution: Blast hole diameter dictates drill pattern spacing, linear charge weight density, and rock fragmentation distribution.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What competency qualification is statutorily required to hold the post of Safety Officer under CMR 2017?
options: Degree in Environmental Science or Safety Engineering
First Class or Second Class Manager's Certificate of Competency
Overman Certificate of Competency with 5 years experience
Mining Sirdar Certificate of Competency with Gas Testing
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 29 specifies that Safety Officers must hold a Manager's Certificate of Competency.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What primary agricultural effect occurs when applying lime to acidic mine spoil dumps?
options: Increases soil salinity and prevents growth of invasive surface weed species
Binds loose coal dust particles and prevents surface dust generation along dumps
Reduces spoil soil moisture retention capacity to accelerate surface slope drying
Neutralizes excess soil acidity and improves nutrient availability for plant growth
questions.solution: Agricultural lime neutralizes acidity in pyritic mine spoil, restoring optimum pH levels for plant growth.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the standard chemical treatment process for managing Acid Mine Drainage (AMD)?
options: Filtration through coarse gravel beds without chemical reagent addition or pH adjustment
Evaporation in unlined shallow surface basins to leave solid salt residues for disposal
Aeration with pure oxygen followed by addition of concentrated sulfuric acid reagents
Neutralization with alkaline reagents like lime followed by heavy metal precipitation and settling
questions.solution: Acid Mine Drainage (AMD) treatment involves raising pH using lime to neutralize acidity and precipitate heavy metal ions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: How frequently must mine management review and audit Safety Management Plans under DGMS guidelines?
options: At least once every 3 years
At least once every 5 years
At least once every 6 months
At least once every year
questions.solution: DGMS Safety Management Plan guidelines require mine management to conduct an annual review and audit of the SMP.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which category of explosives is strictly prohibited in underground coal mines due to firedamp ignition risk?
options: Non-permitted commercial Nitroglycerine dynamites and raw unformulated ANFO mixtures
P3 category permitted explosives approved for solid blasting in coal seam workings
P5 category permitted explosives formulated for delayed firing in gassy seams
P1 category permitted explosives designed specifically for gassy coal seam faces
questions.solution: Non-permitted commercial explosives (e.g., raw ANFO, standard dynamites) are strictly prohibited underground in coal mines due to firedamp ignition risks.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 129, what testing apparatus must a Sirdar carry during routine inspection of fiery seams?
options: A hygrometer and a personal noise exposure dosimeter instrument
A handheld thermal imaging camera and a hydraulic roof prop pressure gauge
A portable anemometer and a digital laser distance measuring meter
An approved Flame Safety Lamp or Methanometer alongside a Carbon Monoxide detector
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129 mandates carrying a flame safety lamp/methanometer and an approved CO detector during inspections in gassy/fiery seams.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What primary hazards are prevented by maintaining robust haul road shoulders and edge berms?
options: Excessive fuel consumption and rapid engine overheating in loaded haul vehicles
Punctures in dumper tires caused by loose sharp rocks scattered on road surfaces
Spontaneous heating in coal seams beneath adjacent pit floor roads
Dumper tipping or rollover accidents and sudden collapse of unstable road edges
questions.solution: Maintaining strong shoulders and berms prevents heavy dumpers from running off haul road edges or causing bank collapse.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.topic: Opencast Machinery & Heavy Earth Moving Equipment
questions.stem: What is the fundamental difference in digging action between a face shovel and a backhoe?
options: Face shovel uses hydraulic cable winches; backhoe relies entirely on gravity bucket drop
Face shovel rotates on track bases; backhoe remains fixed on static hydraulic outriggers
Face shovel digs upward and away from machine; backhoe digs downward and toward machine
Face shovel digs downward and toward machine; backhoe digs upward and away from machine
questions.solution: Face shovels dig upward and outward away from the cab; backhoes dig downward and inward toward the machine track base.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What performance properties make emulsion explosives highly effective in wet blasting conditions?
options: Low density combined with low detonation pressure and slow gas expansion rates
Total absence of chemical oxidizers combined with infinite shelf life stability
High sensitivity to mechanical friction combined with low detonation temperature
High water resistance combined with high Velocity of Detonation (VOD) performance
questions.solution: Emulsions provide superior water resistance and high detonation velocity due to their fine oxidizer-in-oil droplet matrix.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: How is the Break-Even Stripping Ratio (BESR) defined in open pit financial analysis?
options: The ratio where total extraction and processing costs equal total recoverable coal value
The ratio where total overburden volume equals total coal tonnage extracted annually
The ratio where capital equipment purchase costs equal annual pit operating profits
The ratio where diesel fuel expenditure equals total worker salary expenses per shift
questions.solution: The Break-Even Stripping Ratio (BESR) defines the financial threshold where total extraction costs equal net coal market value.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Rule 29U of Mines Rules 1955, at what employment threshold is a Safety Committee mandatory?
options: In mines where more than 100 persons are ordinarily employed
In mines where more than 50 persons are ordinarily employed
In mines where more than 250 persons are ordinarily employed
In mines where more than 500 persons are ordinarily employed
questions.solution: Mines Rules 1955 Rule 29U mandates establishing a Safety Committee in mines employing more than 100 persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which two fundamental variables determine quantitative risk in mine safety assessment matrices?
options: Number of active workers and overall shift coal production tonnage
Depth of mining workings and age of heavy surface earthmoving machinery
Total equipment cost and duration of scheduled operational downtime
Probability of hazard occurrence and Consequence severity of potential harm
questions.solution: In risk management: Risk = Likelihood (Probability) × Consequence (Severity).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What statutory requirement governs the display and communication of Mine Safety Policies under CMR 2017?
options: Published annually in national government gazettes and distributed to local police stations
Printed on worker pay slips and archived in corporate headquarter document databases
Written in English, Hindi, and local vernacular, displayed prominently, and communicated to workers
Filed exclusively in management records and presented during annual regulatory inspections
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 104 requires Safety Policies to be written, translated into local languages, posted across the mine, and explained to workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: According to CMR 2017 Regulation 88, how often must each shaft winding rope be examined?
options: At least once every 7 days (Weekly)
At least once every 30 days (Monthly)
At least once every 24 hours (Daily)
At least once every 14 days (Fortnightly)
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 88(1)(b)(i) requires each winding rope to be examined once at least in every seven days by passing the rope at a speed not exceeding one meter per second.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the minimum statutory safe distance officials must maintain from unstable bench crests?
options: 3 meters from the uncontained edge
5 meters from the uncontained edge
10 meters from the uncontained edge
1 meter from the uncontained edge
questions.solution: Statutory opencast inspection rules state that officials shall not approach within 3 meters of an unstable or uncontained bench crest.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 106, how is maximum bench height regulated in opencast workings?
options: Shall not exceed double the maximum boom length of the deployed loading shovel
Fixed at a rigid maximum limit of 20 meters regardless of machinery type deployed
Regulated strictly by total annual rainfall volume recorded at local weather stations
Shall not exceed the maximum digging reach or height of the deployed excavator
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 106(5) stipulates that bench height in coal and rock overburden shall not exceed the maximum digging height/reach of the excavation machine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What benefit is gained by applying organic amendments to biological spoil reclamation sites?
options: Enhance water-retention capacity, improve soil structure, and reactivate microbial ecology
Increase bulk density of spoil rock and prevent surface water percolation into pit floors
Sterilize topsoil material to eliminate weed seeds prior to commercial tree planting
Accelerate chemical weathering of surrounding hard sandstone boulders on dump slopes
questions.solution: Organic amendments build soil structure, increase moisture retention, and reintroduce essential soil microbial ecology.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the operational purpose of implementing the 'buddy system' in high-risk underground areas?
options: Alternating worker rest breaks between shift hours to maintain unbroken machine operations
Pairing experienced supervisors with trainee officials to complete administrative logbooks
Pairing two workers together so each acts as a safety backup and continuous monitor for the other
Assigning two workers to operate a single hand tool to double shift production output
questions.solution: The buddy system links two workers together so each acts as a safety backup for the other in high-risk zones.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the primary advantage of utilizing air decking techniques in production bench blasting?
options: Increases linear charge density in upper stemming sections without increasing drill depth
Reduces explosive consumption while achieving uniform stress wave distribution along hole length
Eliminates need for delay detonators and allows simultaneous firing of all blast hole rows
Completely prevents ground vibrations and eliminates flyrock hazards during bench firing
questions.solution: Air decking distributes explosive energy along the borehole, lowering explosive mass while maintaining optimal rock fracturing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What operational problem directly results from inadequate sub-drilling depth in bench blasting?
options: Formation of unbroken hard rock toe ridges at floor level that obstruct shovel loading
Increased generation of fine coal dust particles during initial blast hole detonation
Rapid loss of stemming material from upper drill hole sections due to blowouts
Excessive backbreak behind the rear blast row and severe crest instability on benches
questions.solution: Inadequate sub-drilling fails to break floor rock cleanly, creating troublesome high spots or toes that obstruct excavators.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: According to CMR 2017 Regulation 169, at what methane concentration must electric power be cut off?
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 169(1)(e) mandates cutting off electric power immediately if inflammable gas exceeds 1.25% in any ventilating district, and reporting to the Regional Inspector.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Rule 62 of Mines Rules 1955, at what workforce threshold must surface rest shelters be provided?
options: Where more than 500 persons are ordinarily employed
Where more than 50 persons are ordinarily employed
Where more than 150 persons are ordinarily employed
Where more than 20 persons are ordinarily employed
questions.solution: Rule 62 of Mines Rules 1955 requires surface rest shelters in mines where more than 50 persons are ordinarily employed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which combination of infrastructure forms the foundation of an effective open pit dewatering system?
options: Truck-mounted water tankers, gravity flow drainage ditches, and shallow temporary sumps
Submersible slurry pumps, air-lift pumping stations, and unlined highwall catch canals
Deep floor sumps, high-head centrifugal pumps, and perimeter surface runoff catch drains
Sub-surface drainage boreholes, hand-operated diaphragm pumps, and open pit evaporation ponds
questions.solution: Pit dewatering relies on perimeter ditches to intercept runoff, combined with deep sumps and high-head dewatering pumps.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What maximum overall waste dump slope angle is recommended under standard DGMS safety guidelines?
options: 18 degrees (1 in 3)
28 degrees (1 in 2)
37.5 degrees (1 in 1.3)
45 degrees (1 in 1)
questions.solution: DGMS guidelines specify that overall waste dump slope angles should not exceed 28 degrees (1 in 2) to maintain slope stability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: According to CMR 2017 Regulation 129, when must a Sirdar complete and sign statutory inspection reports?
options: Within 24 hours after completion of the statutory shift inspection
At the beginning of the next scheduled working shift period
During weekly safety committee review meetings held at mine headquarters
Before leaving the mine premises at the end of the shift
questions.solution: Reg 129 mandates that inspecting officials complete and sign their statutory reports before exiting the mine premises at shift end.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What are the primary operational objectives of utilizing delay detonators in production blast patterns?
options: Increase airblast pressure waves, delay secondary rock fall, and clean bench floors
Create successive free faces, control rock fragmentation, and minimize peak ground vibrations
Reduce drill pattern hole numbers, increase total explosive charge mass, and eliminate flyrock
Eliminate requirement for stemming material, lower drill hole depth, and prevent misfires
questions.solution: Delay detonators sequence hole firings milliseconds apart, generating consecutive free faces and preventing ground vibration wave superposition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the economically optimal distance range for material pushing using heavy crawler bulldozers?
options: 200 to 500 meters
10 to 20 meters
750 to 1000 meters
50 to 100 meters
questions.solution: Bulldozer pushing is economically efficient over short haul distances (up to 50–100 m); longer distances require haul trucks or scrapers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 129, within what time frame prior to shift commencement must pre-shift inspection occur?
options: Within 4 hours before workers enter the district
Within 1 hour before workers enter the district
Within 30 minutes before workers enter the district
Within 2 hours before workers enter the district
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 129 states that pre-shift inspections by Sirdars must be carried out within 2 hours prior to shift workers entering the district.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What explosive energy component primarily drives rock displacement and heaving after initial shattering?
options: High-velocity shock wave detonation stress peak energy
High-pressure gas volume expansion energy (Bubble Energy)
Thermal radiation heat energy released during oxidation
High-frequency sonic acoustic pulse energy waves
questions.solution: High-pressure gas expansion energy (bubble energy) drives rock displacement and heaving after shock waves shatter the matrix.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What lighting system is statutorily required at key underground junctions under CMR 2017 Reg 175?
options: Individual cap lamp illumination provided by passing shift workers
Approved stationary electric lighting systems powered from main distribution lines
Portable battery-powered LED floodlights mounted on temporary tripod stands
Compressed-air driven pneumatic safety lamps positioned at working faces
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 175 requires adequate general lighting at shaft insets, bottoms, junctions and other listed places belowground, provided by electrical means where electric energy is available at the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What organizational dimensions are assessed when conducting mine safety climate surveys?
options: Individual equipment mechanical availability and annual spare parts consumption rates
Shift wage rates, overtime distribution fairness, and worker canteen meal preferences
Surface atmospheric dust concentrations and local groundwater quality monitoring metrics
Psychological safety culture, workforce safety perceptions, and management commitment levels
questions.solution: Safety climate surveys assess the workforce's perceptions, attitudes, and overall safety culture within the organization.

The Board of Mining Examinations under DGMS
questions.solution: Official competency certificates for Overman, Sirdar, and Managers are issued by the Board of Mining Examinations under DGMS.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If the word SIRDAR is encoded as TJSEBS in a cipher system, how is it derived?
options: TJSEBS
RIQCZQ
UETECT
SHRDAQ
questions.solution: Shift each letter forward by +1 position in the alphabet: S->T, I->J, R->S, D->E, A->B, R->S. Result = TJSEBS.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If an item bought for ₹800 is sold for ₹1,000, what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution: Profit = 1000 - 800 = 200. Profit Percentage = (200 / 800) * 100 = 25%.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Complete the analogy: Book is to Author as Painting is to ________.
options: Sculptor
Musician
Actor
Artist
questions.solution: A book is created by an author; a painting is created by an artist.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Person A completes a task in 10 days and Person B completes it in 15 days. Working together, how many days do they take?
options: 6 days
5 days
7 days
8 days
questions.solution: Combined rate per day = 1/10 + 1/15 = (3 + 2)/30 = 5/30 = 1/6. Total time taken = 6 days.

questions.stem: During which years was the Indian coal mining industry nationalized in phases?
questions.solution: Coking coal mines were nationalized in 1971–1972 and non-coking coal mines in 1973, forming Coal India Limited in 1975.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Pointing to a photograph, Ramesh says 'He is the son of the only daughter of my father'. How is Ramesh related to him?
options: Uncle (Maternal)
Brother
Grandfather
Father
questions.solution: 'Only daughter of my father' = Ramesh's sister. Her son is the man in the photograph. Therefore, Ramesh is his maternal uncle.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Find two consecutive positive even numbers whose product equals 2600.
options: 50 and 52
48 and 50
52 and 54
54 and 56
questions.solution: Let the numbers be x and x+2. x(x+2) = 2600 => x^2 + 2x - 2600 = 0 => (x - 50)(x + 52) = 0 => x = 50. The numbers are 50 and 52.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Find the missing number in the numerical sequence: 4, 9, 19, 39, 79, ____?
questions.solution: Pattern: (Previous Value * 2) + 1. Calculation: (79 * 2) + 1 = 158 + 1 = 159.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If today is Monday, what day of the week will it be exactly 100 days from today?
options: Tuesday
Thursday
Wednesday
Friday
questions.solution: 100 divided by 7 = 14 weeks with a remainder of 2 days. Monday + 2 days = Wednesday.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A boat travels 24 km upstream in 6 hours and 24 km downstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
options: 8 km/hr
5 km/hr
6 km/hr
7 km/hr
questions.solution: Upstream speed = 24 / 6 = 4 km/hr. Downstream speed = 24 / 3 = 8 km/hr. Boat speed in still water = (4 + 8) / 2 = 6 km/hr.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: What is the total sum of all internal angles in a four-sided convex polygon (quadrilateral)?
questions.solution: Sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon = (n - 2) * 180 degrees. For n = 4: (4 - 2) * 180 = 360 degrees.
